preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 250,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 10**6 for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge weight c must be a positive integer between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n and all(0 <= val <= sum(c for a, b, c in edges) for val in output)
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, each representing the minimal total weight of deleted edges for x = 0 to n-1, and each value must be non-negative and not exceed the total weight of all edges.

postconditions.expression: all(output[x] == min(sum(weights) for weights in edge_deletions) for x in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each x in 0..n-1, output[x] is the minimal total weight of edges to delete so that all vertices have degree ≤ x in the remaining graph. edge_deletions is the set of all possible edge deletions that satisfy the degree constraint for x.

postconditions.expression: output[0] == sum(c for a, b, c in edges)
postconditions.description: For x=0, the minimal total weight is the sum of all edge weights (delete all edges).
For x=n-1, no edges need to be deleted (all vertices can have degree ≤ n-1 in a tree).
